SURF1 deficiency is a severe, progressive disorder with a variable phenotype, but the majority of patients present in early infancy with poor weight gain and hypotonia and experience neurological regression.

SURF1 deficiency is the most frequent mitochondrial disorder causing Leigh syndrome.
